Lindley Town Court

Address: 637 County Rd 115, Lindley, NY 14858, United States

Phone: 607-523-8388

Lindley Town Court is a courthouse and is one of the 38 town and village courts in Steuben County, New York. It is situated within the 4th and 7th judicial district departments. This court has jurisdiction over traffic, speeding and vehicle, small claims and other violation-related cases. The court opening days and hours are concise, so you should come to the court for the issues before the opening of the court.

Division:

Lindley Town Court traffic division handles cases of:

  • Speeding Ticket
  • Moving Violation
  • Driving while drinking
  • Driving Recklessly
  • Leave from the accident scene
  • Criminal traffic violation
  • Accident
  • Drugs found in the car
  • Failure to obey the device from traffic controls
  • Driving without a license

Some traffic cases are also solved by submitting a plea form of guilty or not guilty. After submitting the form, the court will respond whether to appear in court or pay a fine only. Hiring an attorney is compulsory in criminal traffic cases for your guidance. If you have difficulty, email the court; they will respond to you with proper guidance.

see also Small Claims Court">Warren Township Small Claims Court

What is the role of a clerk?

Lindley Town Court Clerk's role is to help the judges perform their duties. The clerk's office also contains certificates, copies, and permits; a person had to submit the documents at their office for further case proceedings or papers. They also solve queries, collect fines and help the judge outside the court. The clerk's office is an agent of licensing and custodians of the town records.

How to do a case search?

Lindley Town Court Case Search can be done online using the first and last name, city, or state. After filling in all the data, a person got the case information. Some case information or records are confidential and unavailable online, so you must give a request form to the clerk's office. They will then provide that information to you if necessary.

How to make payments?

Lindley Town Court speeding ticket payment can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can make payment by visiting the court during business hours and paying in cash, checks, or with a card at the counter. Service or deduction charges will be applied if you pay with a credit card.

Online

A person can pay online using a credit card at http://paycourtonline.com/. Processing fees will be applied in this method.

Mail

A Person can send a certified check or money order to the court's mailing address. The address is 637 County Rd 115, Lindley, NY 14858, United States. Do not send cash or personal checks in the mail; only certified checks are accepted.

Phone

Payment can be made by credit card by calling 1-888-912-1541. Convince charges will be applied by this method

see also Yolo County Superior Court

The small claims division handles which types of cases?

Lindley Town Court Small Claims Division handles all the cases in which claims are up to $3000. It also handles rent claims cases with a $3000 limit. The person on which the claim occurred must be a town citizen. The property on which the claim arose must also be in that town. Hiring an attorney is not compulsory in this case, but if you feel difficulty, you can hire or consult a lawyer.

How to get a marriage license?

Lindley Town Court's marriage license is obtained from the clerk's office. The cost is $40, and for each copy, the price is $10. The couple's age must be 18+. The couple must be presented in court when they come for the license. To obtain the permit, the couple had to submit a marriage form with a birth certificate, photo ID like a driver’s license, passport, or anything that could prove their identity. If anyone is divorced, a divorce paper must be submitted before getting support. If anyone wants the copies, fill out the certificated copy of the marriage license request and submit it to the court. After receiving the license, a marriage ceremony is held in court.

When appearing in court is required?

Appearance is required in small claims or criminal traffic cases, but in some traffic cases, you will submit a plea of guilty or not guilty, and after submitting, the court will reply whether you had to appear in court or only a fine is paid, and the case is solved.

FAQ:

What happens if I do not pay the fine on time?

If you do not pay a fine or speeding ticket on time, an extra penalty will be added, your license or insurance will be canceled, and sometimes warrants will be issued against you.

Which proof of identity documents are required for a marriage certificate?

The proof of identity documents required for the marriage license is:

  • Driver’s License
  • Passport
  • Military ID
  • Employee’s Photo ID

What is Lindley Town Hall?

Lindley Town Hall is located in Lindley, New York, and it provides different information like Town Clerk Office Hours, Course information, etc. The town hall contains departments like Town Court, the Town clerk's office, etc.

Which positions are available in the town hall?

The town hall career page will tell you about the latest opening position. The newest work that is available are:

  • Zoning Board of Appeal
  • Secretary for Zoning Board Appeal
  • Board Secretary of Planning

What types of certificates are provided by the clerk's office?

Certificates provided by the clerk's office:

  • Marriage certificate
  • Birth or death certificate
  • Divorce certificate
  • County Tax annually certificate
  • Driver’s License Furnishing

How much is for a birth and death certificate copy?

$10 for each document is the birth and death certificate fee.

How can I contact the clerk's office?
How do I look up court cases in NYC?

You can visit the clerk's office from Monday to Thursday from 9:00 am to 1:00 pm or call or email them for any guidance.

Dial: 607-523-8818

Email: Lindleytc@gmail.com

Looking up court cases in NYC can be done online by using first, last name, and city or state.

When are planning board meetings held?

The Planning board meeting is held every 3rd Monday at 7:00 pm.
